tagline: Swiss International Style — Klein-blue accent on near-white, Inter/Helvetica throughout, Carbon grid system, 22+ layouts, modular spacing.

palette.description: Klein-blue accent on near-white paper — Bauhaus rationalism

best_for: Anything that should feel precise, rational, and systematically organized — design reviews, architecture portfolios, data reports, corporate strategy decks.
avoid_for: Contexts that need warmth, personality, or handcrafted character — the Swiss grid reads as cold and impersonal.
